title: Fleet — Dashboard & Alerts
notes: This slice is a stats dashboard + tabbed alert feed, not a list/detail entity, so listPage/filterBar/infiniteScroll/hoverActions/detailDrawer/relationCombobox/urlPrefill/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput/sendMessageDialog/themedExport do not apply to this archetype. Fixed #76: dashboard page now makes 1 call (GET /fleet/dashboard) instead of 3; the API client normalizes the nested backend payload into the existing flat FleetDashboard shape so the colocated fleet.test.ts contract is unchanged. Fixed #74: alerts page now uses a single unified fleetApi.getExpiringDocuments() call (backend already unions vehicle_documents + driver_documents) instead of two separate calls, plus the existing maintenance-due call — vehicle docs, driver docs, and maintenance are all shown. Replaced raw hex/muted-foreground classes with ds-* tokens, TripStatusBadge/StatCard rewritten onto Tag/StatCard/PageHeader/Skeleton/EmptyState primitives per CONTRACT. Both pages use loading skeletons and EmptyState for zero-alert states.
showcaseScript: Point out utilisation, active trips and revenue tiles
Open Alerts and show expiring documents and maintenance due
